Why Forgetting Matters 🧠

Traditional AI systems are designed to store everything forever. But this leads to information overload, bias accumulation, and privacy risks.

Humans, on the other hand, forget constantly — and that’s what makes us adaptive, creative, and emotionally resilient.

ForgetAI introduces a revolutionary approach where machines learn what to forget and when to forget, enabling better generalization, ethical data handling, and smarter decision-making.
